_comment: Chance per action that a combat ability goes up by one (owner's rules: 15% since 2026-10-15). A skill cast trains the ability on the skill (Ranged Combat, Nature Magic, Fire Magic...); an auto-attack that lands trains the weapon's ability (Bow, Sword, Totem...); every auto-attack that lands trains Critical Strike and every skill hit or heal trains Critical Skills, crit or not (misses, evades and damage-over-time ticks don't). Abilities stop at the cap of ten per character level (2,000 at level 200), the cap the abilities page shows. A skill cast on you trains the defensive ability for its type (Fortitude, Warding, Reflex, Vigour, Willpower). Restart the server after editing. criticalChance (owner's rule, 25% since 2026-10-16): Critical Strike and Critical Skills train with this chance instead of combatChance. dotCriticalChance (owner's rule, 12% since 2026-10-16): every damage-over-time tick from a player's skill (Rupture's bleed, poisons, burns...) can train Critical Skills with this chance.
